en: The postcard consists of two sides: the front features a black-and-white photograph of a large decorative fountain with four seated nude or semi-nude statues at its corners, water cascading over the top, and surrounding city buildings in the background. The caption reads 'GÖTEBORG Järnbrunnen' and the year '1925'. The reverse side contains handwritten Swedish text, an address, a Swedish 10 öre stamp depicting a portrait, and a postmark.
